text:
Anil Srinivasan
Finance & Accounting Professional | Remote
anil.srinivasan180@example.com | +91 9942140565

Results-driven accountant with experience in corporate finance, statutory compliance, and financial reporting for fast-moving consumer and fintech companies. Strong analytical focus with hands-on experience implementing controls, month-end close, and managing GST/TDS compliance. Comfortable working in cross-functional Agile teams and documenting processes in Confluence.

Experience

UrbanPantry — Oct 2022 - Present
Accountant (Remote)
- Managed month-end close activities and prepared financial statements in line with IFRS, reducing reconciliation exceptions by 40% over six months using standardized Excel templates and reconciliations.
- Implemented GST and TDS compliance workflows, automated periodic returns tracking in Microsoft Excel, and achieved 100% on-time filing for all statutory returns for consecutive quarters.
- Led accounting system clean-up and migration prep for Tally Prime integration; mapped chart of accounts and prepared migration scripts, cutting expected post-migration reconciliation effort by 30%.
- Created process documentation in Confluence for accounting policies and controls; introduced checklists and introduced simple macros in Microsoft Excel to speed up account review cycles.

Razorpay — Dec 2021 - Sep 2022
Finance Executive (Remote)
- Performed daily bookkeeping and reconciliations, resolving bank and ledger variances and improving cash posting accuracy by 25% using advanced Microsoft Excel routines.
- Managed GST filing and vendor TDS verifications for payroll and vendor payments, ensuring adherence to statutory requirements and reducing query turnaround time by 20%.
- Supported month-end reporting and provided audit schedules and working papers aligned to SAP FICO reports; coordinated with external auditors to close queries within SLA.
- Documented recurring finance processes in Confluence and collaborated with product and engineering teams in an Agile environment to streamline invoice workflows.

Projects
- Automated GST Return Tracker: Built an Excel-based tracker with validation checks to monitor GST filings and deadlines across states; reduced missed return risks and improved visibility for the finance lead.
- Accounting Migration Playbook: Authored a Confluence playbook detailing steps for migrating ledgers to Tally Prime and mapping SAP FICO extracts for reconciliation purposes.

Skills
Accounting & ERP: Tally Prime, SAP FICO
Tax & Compliance: GST, TDS, IFRS
Tools & Productivity: Microsoft Excel, Confluence
Process & Development: Agile, Git

Education
CA, ICAI

Notice period: 30 days
